specials: A unit of harpies cannot be joined by a character.
dark-elves:harpies.notes: Harpies are based facing the long edge of the base in the same way as infantry, rather than the short edge like other monsters. Harpies can fly.

specials: Generals, Heroes and the Sorceress can ride a Manticore. An extra +2 Attacks are added to those of the rider. A unit joined by the character causes Terror.
dark-elves:manticore.notes: The Manticore can fly increasing the rider‘s movement to 100cm.

specials: A Sorceress can have a Cauldron of Blood. The army can only ever include one Cauldron of Blood and it can only be included if there is at least 1 unit of Witch Elves in the army. The Cauldron of Blood adds +2 Attacks to the Sorceress and can be used to add +1 to the Sorceress‘s dice roll to cast a spell once per battle. The player must announce that the Cauldron of Blood‘s spell bonus is being used before rolling the dice to determine if the spell is cast.
dark-elves:cauldron-of-blood.notes: A Sorceress with a Cauldron of Blood suffers a movement reduction to 30cm.
